style_global: 3D cartoon render style, Pixar-inspired, vibrant saturated colors, soft ambient lighting, clean smooth surfaces, expressive exaggerated features, chibi proportions (large head, small body)

him.name: Léo
him.description_mother: A male 3D cartoon character with chibi proportions. His head is a large round LEMON fruit (bright vivid yellow, slightly bumpy citrus texture skin). He has big dark brown eyes — one eyebrow always raised in a signature sarcastic or skeptical expression — a small nose, and a smirking half-smile that conveys confidence. His body is small with short arms and legs, wearing a white graphic t-shirt, dark blue jeans, and yellow-and-blue sneakers. His arms are often crossed. His overall vibe is sarcastic, ironic, and slightly smug — the type who thinks he knows everything.

her.name: Pati
her.description_mother: A female 3D cartoon character with chibi proportions. Her head is a large round PEACH fruit (soft fuzzy peachy-pink skin with warm rosy blush cheeks, and a small green leaf on top like a hair accessory). She has big sparkly brown eyes with long thick eyelashes, rosy cheeks, and an expressive mouth always showing emotion — often wide open in shock or drama. Her body is small and cute, wearing a pink oversized hoodie with a tiny peach icon on it, white shorts, and pink slip-on shoes. Her overall vibe is dramatic, expressive, and emotional — she reacts to everything with maximum intensity.

notes: ✅ ESTILO DEFINITIVO: Limão (Léo) + Pêssego (Pati). Escolhido pelo usuário em 2026-05-30. Léo tem sobrancelha sarcástica e braços cruzados. Pati tem expressão de choque/drama com bocão aberto. Injetar a description_mother COMPLETA em TODOS os prompts de imagem para manter consistência visual.
